where.if: AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM users u
ORDER BY u.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM users u JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.code = 'admin' AND u.enabled = TRUE AND u.account_locked = FALSE AND u.id <> #{excludeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, email, phone, avatar, password_hash, display_name, enabled, account_locked, account_expired, last_login_at, must_change_password, credentials_expired_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{avatar}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{enabled}, #{accountLocked}, #{accountExpired}, #{lastLoginAt}, #{mustChangePassword}, #{credentialsExpiredAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, avatar = #{avatar}, display_name = #{displayName}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, must_change_password = #{mustChangePassword}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET enabled = #{enabled}, account_locked = #{accountLocked}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET credentials_expired_at = #{credentialsExpiredAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt} WHERE id = #{id}
